note: OWNER DECISION 8 (2026-10-24): constant output pins are dropped from the plan (no face_guard constant class). Each entry: the pins removed from the hard core and why; the RTL ports were narrowed to match. 'rename' (S81-KITS-RTLA 10-24): packed buses keep every surviving pin at its closed-view position under its new bit name (applied once per table, marked by const_rename in the table).

ot_dsrom_su_hcpost_lane_pr.why: BF16 result o <= {hi, 16'd0}: o[15:0] constant 0 (rtl/hdc/v41x/ot_dsrom_su_hcpost.sv); port narrowed to o[31:16]; vp reads lo[31:16] only

dsfd_su_t_rxsb.why: o_r = sqrt(sp) >= 0: sign bit constant 0; port narrowed to o_r[30:0]; receiver of rxsf o_u[31] / o_u2[31]: inputs narrowed to i_u / i_u2 [30:0], rxsb uses {1'b0, i_u}

ot_s81sl_vs.why: receiver of rxsb o_r[31]; port narrowed to ra_ri[30:0], vs uses {1'b0, ra_ri}; applies to both tables of module ot_s81sl_vs (ot_s81sl_vs.json and the re-pinned ot_s81sl_vs_lfp.json + its stub LEF); receiver of ve o_y: input packed to ve_oy[127:0] (renamed like ve), unpacked at voy_c; applies to both vs tables; S81-KITS-RTLA 10-24: s_d[63] / s_d[61] = command imm[31] / imm[29], no command field (no load): port narrowed to s_d[157:0] (new [60:0] = old [60:0], [61] = old [62], [157:62] = old [159:64]); producer vp is leaf glue (soft), the two unloaded bits are removed there by synthesis.  ve_rh / ve_ah = BF16 h ({bf16, 16'd0}, hw32 / hw8 / hw4; TIELO low halves): ports packed to ve_rh[63:0] / ve_ah[127:0], new [16k+j] = old [32k+16+j]; receiver ve unpacks at its input flop

ot_s81sl_vn.why: vn y = 8 BF16 lanes in the upper halves of 32-bit words ({bf16, 16'd0}, TIELO low halves): port packed to y[127:0], new y[16k+j] = old y[32k+16+j]; receiver vq unpacks at its input flop

ot_s81sl_vq.why: receiver of vn y: input packed to y[127:0] (renamed like vn), unpacked {y[16k+:16],16'd0} at the input flop; applies to ot_s81sl_vq.json and ot_s81sl_vq_lfp.json (+ its stub LEF)

ot_s81sl_ve.why: ve o_y = {rounded[31:16], 16'd0} per lane: port packed to o_y[127:0], new o_y[16k+j] = old o_y[32k+16+j]; receiver vs unpacks at its input flop; S81-KITS-RTLA 10-24: receiver of vs ve_rh / ve_ah (packed BF16): inputs r_h[63:0] / a_h[127:0], new [16k+j] = old [32k+16+j], unpacked ({h, 16'd0}) at the input flop

dsfd_su_t_rxsf.why: u = t / (t + 2) >= 0 and u^2: sign bits constant 0 (TIELO in the raw netlist); ports narrowed to o_u / o_u2 [30:0]

dsdv_eng_rr_e.why: rco[35:32] = request sector bits [29:26] = PCBASE[29:26] (sector = PCBASE + atom[30:5], a 26-b offset; PCBASE[25:0] == 0 checked in the unit wrapper; TIELO in the raw netlist at the kit's PCBASE 0): port narrowed to rco[38:0], new rco[31:0] = old [31:0], new rco[38:32] = old [42:36]; dsdv_eng_rr_split re-inserts PCBASE[29:26].  pci[4:1] = response-chain own field, not read by the core (head reads v / tag / d): port narrowed to pci[263:0], new pci[0] = old [0], new pci[263:1] = old [267:5].  Producer u_etap_15.pco[4:1] (dsdv_eng_tap, reused by etap_01..15) keeps the field: the next tap reads own.  rco[31:25] are NOT dropped: their earlier raw-netlist constant was the csa31 slang bug (fixed in ot_s81eng_rr_n32.sv).
